{{dablink|For the girl who lives in [[Emond's Field]], see [[Kari Thane]]. For others with the same surname, see [[al'Thor]].}}
'''Kari al'Thor''' was a merchant's daughter from [[Caemlyn]] who lived in Illian. She was a good mother and a loving wife. She was married to [[Tam al'Thor]].

==History==
Kari al'Thor, a red haired,{{ref/book|1|16}} gray-eyed{{ref/book|1|51}} [[Andoran]], was born a merchant's daughter. Her parents set up shop in Illian, which is where she met [[Tam al'Thor]] in {{ne|962}}, who was then in the [[Illianer Companions]]. Her parents disapproved of her relationship to a soldier, but could not stop it due to Tam's position; they did disown her after she married Tam, though.

Kari accompanied Tam on his long campaigns during the [[Aiel War]]. She had two children: a girl who died of fever in infancy and a stillborn boy. After that, she could not bear children anymore. In late {{ne|978}}, Tam found [[Rand al'Thor|Rand]] on the slopes of Dragonmount, and she and Tam adopted him.

The family then went to the [[Two Rivers]].{{ref/book|1|6}} Tam mentions that she always disapproved of his sword.{{ref/book|1|5}} She died when Rand was very young and he scarcely remembers her. Rand remembers her as a good mother with a kind smile and gentle hands. She died in 984NE, when Rand was five years old.{{ref/book|1|6}}{{ref/book|7|3}} During Rand's confrontation with [[Ba'alzamon]], Kari is used a pawn against Rand. She appears before the Dragon Reborn, surrounded by [[Fade]]s, who strip and assault her. Rand uses a sword of Light to destroy the [[Shadowspawn]] and free her.
